newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps downgrades Best Buy notes.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps downgrades Best Buy notes.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it downgraded Best Buy Co Inc's $150 million senior subordinated notes to Single B from Double B and about $22 million of subordinated notes to Single B from Double B.
In addition, $230 million of convertible monthly income preferred securities of Best Buy Capital LP have been downgraded to Single B Minus from Single B Plus, it said.
Duff & Phelps said these actions reflect its continuing concerns about the beleaguered personal computer and consumer electronics businesses, which are Best Buy's largest selling categories.
It noted that operating performance for the third fiscal quarter ended November 30 was considerably weaker than anticipated.
